error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE: "[UE 0] CB-RA: Contention resolution timer has expired, RA procedure has failed..."  
Context: This error occurs repeatedly after the RA-Msg3 transmission in the function/location related to the contention-based random access (CB-RA) procedure, indicating that the contention resolution timer expired and the random access procedure failed, preventing successful UE access and connection establishment.
